accountId.description: The account to fetch emails from.

ids.description: IDs of the emails to fetch. Omit or pass null to fetch all (subject to limit).

properties.description: Email properties to include in the response. Omit for all properties.

bodyProperties.description: Properties to include for each body part object. Defaults to a standard set.

fetchTextBodyValues.description: If true, fetch the value of text/plain body parts.

fetchHTMLBodyValues.description: If true, fetch the value of text/html body parts.

fetchAllBodyValues.description: If true, fetch all body part values regardless of content type.

maxBodyValueBytes.description: Truncate body values to this many bytes. 0 means no truncation.

fetchHeaders.description: List of specific header field names to return as header: values.

fetchAllHeaders.description: If true, return all raw headers regardless of fetchHeaders list.
